text:
deploy-bot: kickoff: rolling v2 for /embed and /generate. slice 7/10 scheduled now. deploy-id=rb-7012345678. watchers: @zara @ben. 20m watch window.
zara: taking ops lead. FYI mobile SDK telemetry previously showed Accept-Version absence -> fallback quirks. I'll pre-pin high-risk tenants.
ben: ran quick sim earlier — saw an uptick in connection resets from legacy mobile clients hitting v2 streaming path. Not huge but repeatable in EU. Suggest pinning tenants with >30% legacy sdk.
priya: agree. I'm adding a temporary deploy rule: any tenant with sdk_version < 3.4.0 -> sticky to v1 for 48h unless manually cleared.
dan: can we automate pin expiry? want to avoid stale pins.
zara: yes, deploybot supports expiry. I'll apply pins with --expires=2026-04-05T12:00:00Z.
deploy-bot: applying tenant pins for slice pre-check: 3 tenants matched. executing pins.
deploy-bot: pin applied: t-441 -> v1 (rb-7012345678-pinA), t-552 -> v1 (rb-7012345678-pinB), t-663 -> v1 (rb-7012345678-pinC).
ben: re-run smoke: EU p50 latency +10ms, 429s stable. no further resets in 10m. good to continue to slice 8.
priya: adding rollback criteria: sustained error_rate_v2 >= 3% for 10m OR stream_reset_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> immediate rollback. also latency p95 > 900ms for 3m -> fallback.
dan: documenting in runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/v2-rollout. add note about SDK header and retry jitter.
zara: sending short release note blurb to docs: "Add X-Api-Version header to guarantee v2 behavior; clients without header may be routed to v1 during staged rollout. See SDK upgrade guidance."
deploy-bot: watch window in progress. alert channel set to #eng-oncall. will post final status when slice finishes.
priya: leaving this as the decision thread for preemptive pinning + expiry. will unpin after 48h unless we see issues.
ben: 👍 will collect traffic snapshots for post-deploy analysis.
